entries.name: Mas Colas municipal veterinary clinic (Fundacion Manchitas)
entries.address: Los Andes 2, behind the sports court and next to the Los Andes 2 school
entries.duty: Low-cost municipal clinic: Mon-Fri 7:00-20:00 (closed Tuesdays), weekends 9:00-16:00; consultations, surgery, vaccination, sterilisation and hospitalisation; WhatsApp for information.
entries.note: Source is TVN news (23 Apr 2026), no own website found. Article hours conflict on Tuesdays (one text says closed Tuesdays, Mon-Fri 7-20); duty text omits the Tuesday detail. No 24 h mention. Phone is WhatsApp.

duty_i18n.it: Clinica comunale a basso costo: lun–ven 7:00–20:00 (chiusa il martedì), weekend 9:00–16:00; visite, chirurgia, vaccinazioni, sterilizzazioni e ricovero; WhatsApp per informazioni.

entries.name: Complejo Hospitalario Veterinario de Corozal (Universidad de Panama)
entries.duty: University veterinary hospital for small species, open 8:00-17:00; fees depend on the service.
entries.note: Official UP service catalogue pp.110-111: hours 8:00-17:00, tel/fax 317-6494, 'todos estos servicios en pequenas especies'. No street address and no web page of its own opened; catalogue date not verified, so hours may be outdated. Rest of the 247k-char catalogue (offset 100000+) not read.

duty_i18n.it: Ospedale veterinario universitario per piccoli animali, aperto 8:00–17:00; tariffe in base al servizio.

notes: Panama: only 11 entries (9 Black Dog branches, Mas Colas, UP Corozal hospital); 0 x 24 h. The fetch tool only opens URLs that surfaced in search results and almost no Panamanian clinic domain surfaced, so own sites could not be opened for: Hospital Veterinario Melo / Melo Pet & Garden (melopetandgarden.com; Los Libertadores, Rio Abajo - named '24 Horas' in a directory), American Pets Parque Omar (americanpetspanama.com), Grupo Felino Canino / Dra. Ximena Hales (grupofelinocanino.com), Pet Club (veterinariapetclub.com), Hospital Veterinario Assu Nele (assunel.com), Dr Gutierrez, Pet Services, Univet, Mundo Animal, Pets Village, Vets 4 Pets, Azuero Pets (Cocle). Chiriqui leads from chiriqui.life Maggie's List (community forum, not used as a source): David - Dr. Claudio Garcia (listed 24-hour clinic), Dr. Moises Lezcano (listed 24/7), Hospital Veterinario Happy Pet (Doleguita), Clinica Vet Don Henry, Clinica Belen; Boquete - Clinica y Farmacia Veterinaria San Jose (Dr. Jose Batista); Vet-on-Wheels (Dolega, mobile, 24/7 claim, vetonwheelspanama.com blocked). Nothing found for Bocas del Toro (expatexchange thread failed), Colon, Playa Blanca or Azuero. The Colegio de Medicos Veterinarios de Panama and MIDA clinic lists could not be found or opened. No duty rota (guardia) found. No animal poison information line found. A public pet hospital in Panama is planned for 2027 (news only), not open.
